title: x402 Exact Solana Payment Outcome Recompute
description: Recompute, clause by clause, whether a pasted x402 exact-scheme Solana payment met its requirements: the decoded instructions, the PaymentRequirements, the mint token program and optional Token-2022 fee config, and optional Ed25519 checks. Each clause reports the pinned spec reading, the pinned reference-code reading, and a verdict of PASS, FAIL or DIVERGES, plus the recipient ATA under both token programs and the net amount after any withheld fee. Values only; nothing on-chain is read.

requirements.description: The x402 PaymentRequirements for the exact scheme.

asset.description: The mint address, base58 (decodes to 32 bytes).

amount.description: The required amount in base units, decimal string, u64 range.

pay_to.description: The recipient wallet, base58 (32 bytes). The destination ATA derives from this.

extra.description: Scheme extras. fee_payer is required; memo and transaction_versions are optional. splits is refused (out of scope for this version).

fee_payer.description: The sponsor fee payer, base58 (32 bytes), as carried by the facilitator /supported response.

memo.description: When present, exactly one Memo instruction must carry this text byte for byte.

transaction_versions.description: The message versions the requirements advertise: JSON integers 0 and/or 1 only. Absent means [0].

transaction.description: The decoded transaction message fields, pasted by the caller. Lookup-table accounts must be pasted resolved.

version.description: The message version: 0, 1 or "legacy" (legacy is deprecated and fails the version clause).

instructions.description: Decoded instructions in order. transfer_checked carries its parsed fields; is_inner: true marks a caller-pasted inner (CPI) instruction.

token_program.description: For transfer_checked: the token program the instruction runs under.

source.description: For transfer_checked: the source token account, base58.

mint.description: For transfer_checked: the mint the transfer moves, base58.

destination.description: For transfer_checked: the destination token account, base58.

authority.description: For transfer_checked: the authority (owner or delegate) signing the transfer, base58.

amount.description: For transfer_checked: the transferred amount in base units, decimal string.

decimals.description: For transfer_checked: the decimals operand of TransferChecked.

is_inner.description: True when the caller pastes this as an inner (CPI) instruction rather than a top-level one.

micro_lamports.description: For compute_unit_price: the price in microlamports, decimal string.

program_id.description: For other: the program id, base58.

accounts.description: For other: the instruction accounts, base58, ALT-resolved.

token_program.description: The token program the mint lives under.

transfer_fee.description: Optional Token-2022 transfer-fee extension configuration. When absent, no fee is withheld.

transfer_fee_basis_points.description: The fee in basis points, u16 range.

maximum_fee.description: The fee cap in base units, u64 range.

signature_checks.description: Optional Ed25519 checks over caller-pasted bytes; the node never re-serializes anything.

public_key.description: The Ed25519 public key, base58 (32 bytes).

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: requirements, transaction, mint, signature_checks.
author: PostOakLabs

verdicts.question: does the matched transfer carry the required amount
verdicts.spec_reading: x402-foundation/x402 at commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7 (canonical repo), specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md L150 (S1.1: a transfer of at least PaymentRequirements.amount) and L187-L192 (S1.4: a matching transfer MAY exceed the amount, overpayment is tolerated; it MUST NOT be less): >= required
verdicts.reference_reading: typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/exact/facilitator/{scheme.ts,smartWalletVerification.ts} at the same commit: scheme.ts L1160 rejects amount !== requirements.amount (static path, exact); smartWalletVerification.ts L657-L662 and L727-L781 accept t.amount >= requiredAmount; L795-L803 and L837-L844 accept balanceAfter - balanceBefore >= requiredAmount
verdicts.evidence: instruction amount 1000000 equals required 1000000: every reading accepts

verdicts.question: is there exactly one transfer matching mint, destination ATA and token program
verdicts.spec_reading: x402-foundation/x402 at commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7 (canonical repo), specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md L187-L189 (S1.4: exactly one transfer MUST match across top-level instructions and the full CPI trace; zero matches MUST be rejected; more than one MUST be rejected as ambiguous)
verdicts.reference_reading: typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/exact/facilitator/{scheme.ts,smartWalletVerification.ts} at the same commit: scheme.ts parses the single TransferChecked in the static layout; smartWalletVerification.ts L727-L781 collects matching inner transfers and L781 accepts when matching.length >= 1
verdicts.evidence: exactly one pasted instruction (index 0) is a TransferChecked of the required mint to the recomputed destination ATA under its own token program

verdicts.question: does the matched transfer pay the recomputed recipient ATA under the relevant token program
verdicts.spec_reading: x402-foundation/x402 at commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7 (canonical repo), specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md L166-L174 (S1.2: correct destination account, the ATA derived from pay_to and asset under the relevant token program; correct token program, spl-token or token-2022)
verdicts.reference_reading: typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/exact/facilitator/{scheme.ts,smartWalletVerification.ts} at the same commit: scheme.ts derives the expected ATA for the parsed TransferChecked; the derivation under the classic program only is the wrong-derivation class the pinned ATA source deprecates for Token-2022 mints
verdicts.evidence: instruction 0 destination equals the recomputed ATA under token-2022 (H6Rg1aU5iPZoMBp6iZg4wquRGCaqARBZHmcxaEk8zCu2)

verdicts.question: is the fee payer absent from every instruction account and role
verdicts.spec_reading: x402-foundation/x402 at commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7 (canonical repo), specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md L276-L292 (S2.1.1: the feePayer MUST NOT appear in the accounts list of any instruction, MUST NOT be invoked as a program, MUST NOT be an authority, source or delegate; the feePayer MAY appear as the payment recipient when feePayer == pay_to)
verdicts.reference_reading: typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/exact/facilitator/{scheme.ts,smartWalletVerification.ts} at the same commit: the static path checks that the facilitator signers are not the transfer authority (scheme.ts L1112-L1115); the account-by-account isolation scan above implements the spec rule, which is broader than that single check
verdicts.evidence: the fee payer 3m8q4EK2PRBFQSZrpnqB7xFAn5ovhhxYG6kCUwjhe4xF appears in no pasted instruction account, is no transfer source or authority, and is invoked as no program

verdicts.question: does the recipient net at least the required amount after any Token-2022 transfer fee
verdicts.spec_reading: x402-foundation/x402 at commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7 (canonical repo), specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md L446 (S3.4 fallback: the destination ATA balance delta, a net quantity on a transfer-fee mint, MUST be >= the required amount); the spec text never mentions the Token-2022 transfer-fee extension by name (no transfer-fee or withheld wording anywhere in the document)
verdicts.reference_reading: typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/exact/facilitator/{scheme.ts,smartWalletVerification.ts} at the same commit: scheme.ts L1160 compares the gross instruction amount; smartWalletVerification.ts L795-L803 and L837-L844 compare the net balance delta; GHSA-725g-w329-g7qr (kora-lib, Token-2022 Transfer Fee Not Deducted During Payment Verification, severity medium) hits exactly this seam
verdicts.evidence: gross 1000000 equals required and net 1000000 is at least required: both readings accept

verdicts.question: when a memo is required, does exactly one memo instruction carry it byte for byte
verdicts.spec_reading: x402-foundation/x402 at commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7 (canonical repo), specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md L410-L411 (Path 1: when extra.memo is present the facilitator MUST verify exactly one Memo instruction exists and its data matches extra.memo encoded UTF-8)
verdicts.reference_reading: typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/exact/facilitator/{scheme.ts,smartWalletVerification.ts} at the same commit: the memo count and byte match run on the static layout (scheme.ts memoInstructions filter) and mirror on Path 2 (smartWalletVerification memo enforcement)
verdicts.evidence: requirements.extra.memo is absent, so the memo rule does not bind; 0 memo instruction(s) pasted are counted as layout facts only

verdicts.question: is the pasted message version one the requirements advertise
verdicts.spec_reading: x402-foundation/x402 at commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7 (canonical repo), specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md L200+ (S1.5: extra.transactionVersions carries the JSON integers 0 and/or 1, default [0] when absent; a message version outside the advertised set fails closed as unsupported_transaction_version) and L215 (legacy messages are deprecated and never advertised)
verdicts.reference_reading: typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/exact/facilitator/{scheme.ts,smartWalletVerification.ts} at the same commit: scheme.ts L359-L364 and L767-L774 read the wire version before signature work (peekWireTransactionVersion, isAcceptedTransactionVersion) and refuse with ErrUnsupportedTransactionVersion
verdicts.evidence: message version 0 is inside the advertised set [0]

output_example.note: Clause-verdict recompute of an x402 exact-scheme Solana payment over pasted values only. Spec readings pinned at x402-foundation/x402 at commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7 (canonical repo), specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md; reference readings at typescript/packages/mechanisms/svm/src/exact/facilitator/{scheme.ts,smartWalletVerification.ts} at the same commit. The amount clause is where the readings split: the spec outcome definition accepts overpayment (S1.4 L187-L192) while the static path rejects any amount inequality (scheme.ts L1160), and the smart-wallet paths accept gross >= (smartWalletVerification.ts L657-L662, L727-L781) and net-delta >= (L795-L803, L837-L844). On a Token-2022 transfer-fee mint the static path compares the gross instruction amount while the balance-delta readings compare the net, so one payment can pass one path and fail another; the withheld amount is min(ceil(gross*bps/10000), maximum_fee), the Token-2022 arithmetic (copied from the estate transfer-fee node). Both Kora advisories name these seams (GHSA-725g-w329-g7qr and GHSA-x442-m7cc-hr92, severity field medium on both records, patched_versions null on both (GitHub advisory API, 2026-10-29)). Transaction V1 is no longer spec-undefined: S1.5 (L200+) defines version admission and the reference implements it (scheme.ts L359-L364, L767-L774), so the staged spec-undefined clause was dropped at the re-pin and replaced by this admission rule. The recipient ATA is derived under both token programs with the chain predecessor derivation (seeds [wallet, token program id, mint] under ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL). Limits: only pasted instructions are matched (top-level plus any the caller marks is_inner); the spec S1 rule spans the full CPI trace, so a smart-wallet payment whose inner instructions are not pasted shows matching_count 0, never a verdict the bytes cannot support; lookup-table accounts must be pasted resolved; splits are refused. This kernel reads nothing on-chain, calls no facilitator, checks no balance and moves no funds; verdict vocabulary is PASS, FAIL, DIVERGES, SPEC_UNDEFINED.
